name: adv_diag_unknown_port_rejected
source:
// connect() names a port the component does not declare.
ThermalSource HOT(T = 400)
Conduction    CD(k = 10, area = 1, L = 0.1)
connect(HOT.porte, CD.a)
t = CD.a.T

error.message: connect(...): 'hot.porte' is not a port (instance.port) or a stream name. connect(HOT.porte,CD.a)
